before_snapshot.comment:
4-HO-TEMPO is modeled based on the production process described in "US5629426A, 1995". First, 4-OH-TEMP, EDTA disodium salt dehydrate, and anhydrous sodium carbonate were mixed with deionized water at 60 ℃. Next, 50% hydrogen peroxide is added slowly to the mixture and then stirred for 18 h. The conversion of 4-HO-TEMPO is 99.2%.

The original inventory is presented in: "Zhang, S., Ramanujam, A. S., Arvidsson, R., Michieletto, A., & Schubert, U. S. (2025). Prospective life cycle assessment of organic redox flow batteries. EES Batteries. doi: https://doi.org/10.1039/D4EB00027G"
before_snapshot.source: Zhang, S., Ramanujam, A. S., Arvidsson, R., Michieletto, A., & Schubert, U. S. (2025). Prospective life cycle assessment of organic redox flow batteries. EES Batteries. doi: https://doi.org/10.1039/D4EB00027G
